scope: Independent read-only dimension audit of exact BOM switch Omron SS-01GL2 against current R3 source. Manufacturer PDF pages4 and6 rendered and visually inspected, pages1/3/7 read. No R3 edits; no exact manufacturer STEP received or modified in this audit.
method: Manufacturer PDF visually reviewed at150dpi plus300/600dpi detail renders in /tmp. Source coordinates compared analytically. Tab envelopes are bounding boxes derived from drawing dimensions, not exact terminal profiles. No scale inference used for normative dimensions.

orientation.manufacturer_height_v_to_world: X = V +14; main body bottom V0
orientation.OP_FP_reference: Mounting-axis line X16.5, not main housing bottom X14

manufacturer_characteristics.RF_note: Reference values apply when lever weight is not applied to the plunger.
manufacturer_characteristics.mounting_instruction: M2.3 mounting screws with plane/spring washers; flat surface; manufacturer torque0.23..0.26N·m for that specified arrangement. Do not transfer this torque to the current M2/printed heat-set arrangement.

main_body.dimension_result: Major nominal19.8x10.2x6.4 dimensions match. Plain cuboid omits detailed cover step, corner/lug profiles, terminal geometry, plunger and real hinge mechanism.

mount_holes.result: Nominal position, spacing and diameter match drawing. Current CAD contains only the two fastener holes, not the extra middle Ø2.5hole.

mount_hardware.current: Existing2xM2x10 plus thin washer into M2 insert pilots; fasteners absent as solids.
mount_hardware.deviation: Manufacturer mounting guidance specifies M2.3. Current M2 fit/clamping and washer coverage require physical/engineering confirmation; do not quote manufacturer M2.3 torque as current-joint approval.

lower_mount_lugs.result: Bounding extent omitted. Exact lug radius/profile not fully dimensioned in available2Ddrawing.

roller.result: Nominal roller size matches; axle/bracket details absent.

lever.current: Ø0.9 cylinder from(25.5,-14.1,9.2) to computed roller centre
lever.manufacturer: Formed0.3mm stainless strip and real hinge/plunger assembly
lever.result: Deliberate illustrative mechanism, not manufacturer geometry or a qualified motion model. Drawing does not fully define an exact hinge pivot/strip profile.

cam_and_timing.result: The source correctly places nominal OP on the mounting-axis datum, but treats maximum FP as an exact free position and assumes a fixed-length hinged lever. Nominal1mm trip lead is not tolerance-qualified; OP spread alone gives0.2..1.8mm post-trip motion at the stop. OT1.2 is a minimum, not a maximum allowable total travel; actual safe endpoint and switch state need confirmation. Preserve manual cam reset and firmware failsafe.

solder_terminals.derivation: U1.6 then+8.8 then+7.3 from body end; Y=U-17. Endview gives3.2tab width at body midplane and6.4projection from the mount-axis line. Ø1.6solder holes exist; their exact positions/corners are not fully dimensioned here.
solder_terminals.limit: Drawing-envelope conflict is not a Boolean test of a factory STEP solid. Do not call terminal fit proven from old proxy validity. Solder blobs, insulated leads, bend radii and unusedNOtab add further packaging needs.

recommendations: Obtain exact SS-01GL2 solder-terminal manufacturer STEP; preserve its geometry and identity, and align using both mounting axes plus the broad mounting face. A SS-5GL2 orD/Tvariant file must not silently substitute for the exact BOM part.
Check imported terminal/lug/body contacts against native P01/P05/H12 at preload0and2, then operating stroke and service motions; include solder/wire keepouts.

Treat imported static actuator geometry as a purchased-shape reference; retain clearly labeled motion envelopes or separate kinematic representation for free/OP/end positions without reshaping the supplied factory solid.
Resolve any confirmed terminal/P05 interference before claiming the actual switch installation works throughout preload adjustment.
Verify real NC opening point, available total travel and manual cam locking after preload change; static geometry alone does not authorize force/peak output or alter failsafe firmware.
